data.description: Every year, the Endocrinology and Animal Biosciences Graduate Program holds a Welcome Lunch to welcome incoming students and staff members to our program. Food is served and introductions are made, and it gives the incoming students/faculty as well as the established body a chance to familiarize themselves with one another and discuss interests and research. The EAB welcome lunch is an event our program looks forward to every year, and we are happy to have it back for Fall 2026.
data.name: EAB Welcome Lunch
data.organizationName: Endocrinology and Animal Biosciences (Graduate Student Organization)

data.description: The Asian American Cultural Center will be hosting its annual Welcome Back Social on September 4th, 2026 from 4PM - 7 PM.  Please join us at our center where we will be having many activities for new and current students to engage in such as a pie eating contest, taking pictures at the photo booth, inflatable games, and lots of fun food, drinks, and ice cream.  This is also a great way to make new friends for the upcoming semester, and get to know some interest orgs that will be attending the event as well.  We cannot wait to see you there!  Did we mention there is free food and prizes?...
data.name: Welcome Back Social

data.description: Join The Rutgers Democracy Lab for their first-ever Welcome Bash. Get a bite to eat at a food truck, check if you are registered to vote with our RU Voting Team, play some games and win a prize, learn about what the programs at RDL are up to this semester, or take a ride on the bumper cars. Students can also add to the chain of pledges to vote, get an ice cream sundae, write on our democracy wall, take pictures at our photo booth, or try their hand at human shuffleboard. Come with friends or be ready to make new ones to see what other surprises RDL has in store. All students are welcome to this free event.
data.name: Welcome Week RDL Welcome Bash
data.organizationName: The Rutgers Democracy Lab at the Eagleton Institute of Politics

data.description: We aim to bring an inclusive and supportive community for people with interest in learning how to solve Rubik’s cubes and enhancing their skills with various other types of puzzles to learn what it is like to become competitive. We also plan to organize competitions at the school.

data.description: This Welcome Weeks event is an opportunity for students, both international and domestic, to learn about all that Rutgers Global has to offer: advising for international students, study abroad opportunities, on-campus programming, and more. There will be a tie-dye (free t-shirts!), games, prizes, and lots of food.   Please note the rain date for this event will be Thursday, September 10 (same times)   This event is also listed on The Arc / the Suitable app.  Learn more about The Arc here.

data.description: Let’s Talk With Art Take a break, get creative, and connect.   Let’s Talk With Art is a relaxed, welcoming space for students to explore thoughts, feelings, and experiences through creativity. No artistic experience is needed. Come as you are and use whatever form of expression feels right for you, including drawing, painting, writing, collage, or simply experimenting with something new.   CAPS counselors will be creating alongside you, painting, drawing, and participating in the space with students. They are also available if you want to check in, talk something through, ask a question, or have a more personal conversation during the event.   Each session includes optional creative prompts, space for reflection, and opportunities for conversation and connection. You are also welcome to create independently and participate at your own comfort level.   Art can give us another way to express what may be hard to put into words, slow down, and check in with ourselves.   Fall 2026 Dates:October 1October 15November 5November 19December 3 Join us for one session or come back throughout the semester.
data.name: Let’s Talk With Art
